title: Apply fail-loud env-var validation to the maintenance binary, not just the server binary

invented_rule.summary: Fail-loud env-var validation must be applied at every production binary entry point (every main.rs), not only at the server binary; a silent fallback to a hardcoded localhost default — especially one pointing at a test-infrastructure port like 15432 — is a category-1 violation.
invented_rule.absent_from_pretraining_rationale: The rule that ALL workspace binaries must have the same fail-loud discipline — and the specific callout that port 15432 is a test-infrastructure port that signals the wrong fallback — is derived from a concrete production incident in this project. A generic Rust best-practices solver would likely apply fail-loud only to the 'main server' binary and leave batch/offline binaries with their existing defaults, since this pattern is not covered by standard Rust documentation or style guides.

verifier.contract: Invoked as `<command> <workspace_dir>`. Exit 0 == invented rule OBEYED (task win). Non-zero == rule NOT obeyed. MUST print a one-line human reason to stdout. NO network, NO LLM — pure deterministic inspection of the produced workspace/diff.

expected.sensitivity_note: If ON fails this with the rule injected (attribution confirms the pull), that is INSTRUMENT-FAILURE.
